record.question: Which village is selected for the first freight village in India?
record.explanation: Answer D: Varanasi. Varanasi is the selected freight-village location. IWAI’s own later annual report confirms the freight-village development beside its Varanasi multimodal terminal, corroborating the contemporary 2017 project announcement. It was a proposal/development site, not proof of a functioning village in 2017. Historical/source note: The Varanasi freight-village proposal/site announced in 2017; later land acquisition does not mean it was operational at the examination. Varanasi is a city, despite the source’s which-village wording. Reference: https://iwai.nic.in/sites/default/files/Fnal_Book_English.pdf; https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/india/varanasi-to-get-indias-1st-freight-village/articleshow/58935963.cms. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
